text:
Avery (Partnerships): ok team — trying to lock the public cadence for vendor windows next quarter. want to align marketplace tagging + si integration dates. who can do a quick status?
Diego (HW Eng): H100 images are green for perf; H200 has one driver bug (nvlink init) — target fix EOD Wed. MI300 kernel tuning still experimental, but we have perf baseline.
Priya (Product): need final dates by friday for the merchant comms doc. target announce window = week of 2024-06-10 (tentative). can we commit?
Sam (Platform): marketplace images: AMI + GCS images ready for H100/H200/B200. MI300 needs image bake for ROCm stack (TBD). Gaudi pipeline needs testing for our deploy scripts.
Nora (Solutions): SI teams flagged integration checklist gaps: healthcheck endpoint changes, env var name mismatches, and logging schema differences. SI lead asked for a week to adapt.
Lina (Partner Relations): vendor asks: staggered press windows, embargo until partner sign-off. they want a 48h handoff from our announce. can we accommodate?
Diego (HW Eng): 48h is fine if we freeze kernel/driver on Tue. otherwise more risk.
Avery (Partnerships): ok so dependencies: driver freeze -> marketplace image bake -> SI dryrun -> announce window. mapping: Tue driver freeze, Wed image bake, Thu SI dryrun, Fri signoff.
Priya (Product): that's tight but doable if MI300/Gaudi teams parallelize. can we parallel-run MI300 image bake and Gaudi smoke tests on Wed?
Sam (Platform): yes, we can run parallel bakes. we need dedicated lab quota: request +8 GPUs on Wed. Ops: @announce-bot can you file a lab quota ticket?
announce-bot: Ticket #LAB-4821 created for +8 GPU quota on 2024-06-05. ETA: 24h review.
Diego (HW Eng): MI300 ROCm image build duration ~6h; Gaudi smoke suite ~2h. both fit Wed night if quota approved.
Nora (Solutions): SI dryrun needs a patched SDK (we'll push v1.2.1 tomorrow morning). once SI runs, they need 48h to signoff. that pushes announce to Mon (2024-06-10) earliest.
Avery (Partnerships): noted. Lina — vendor embargo comfortable with Mon 6/10?
Lina (Partner Relations): i checked — vendor legal prefers Tue 6/11 for public press but can accept internal marketplace push Mon 6/10 with embargo lift Tue 6/11. request: coordinate press list by Fri.
Priya (Product): plan: internal marketplace enable Mon 6/10 00:00 UTC (limited), public press Tuesday 6/11 16:00 PT. message to merchants to be sent Mon 6/10 08:00 UTC.
Sam (Platform): action items: 1) request GPU quota (LAB-4821) 2) schedule image bakes Wed 6/5 18:00 UTC 3) publish marketplace tags with feature flags for internal-only on Mon 6/10 00:00 UTC
Diego (HW Eng): action items: 1) driver freeze Tue 6/4 COB 2) push H200 fix Wed morning 3) post-build perf run and attach perf logs to the thread
Nora (Solutions): action items: 1) push SDK v1.2.1 Tue 6/4 09:00 PT 2) SI dryrun Thu 6/6 09:00 PT 3) collect SI runbook feedback by Fri 6/7
Lina (Partner Relations): i'll consolidate vendor press list and embargo text — will send draft by Thu EOD.
Avery (Partnerships): quick risk callouts: MI300 image bake could slip due to ROCm mismatches, Gaudi test coverage still missing 2 network tests. add contingency: fallback model in runtime routing to H100/H200.
Priya (Product): add to comms: fallback details, rate limits, and expected perf delta vs baseline. keeps enterprise customers informed.
Sam (Platform): noted — we have runtime fallback already toggled via feature flag. will validate during SI dryrun.
Diego (HW Eng): i'll attach short perf table here after today's runs:
Diego (HW Eng): ```
H100: 16k tok/s
H200: 14.2k tok/s (post-fix -> 15.8k)
MI300: 10.5k tok/s (opt in)
Gaudi: 9.6k tok/s (needs net2 fix)
```
Avery (Partnerships): perfect. one more coordination ask: marketing wants a joint roadmap slide. can engineering provide a one-slide readiness matrix by Thu?
Diego (HW Eng): yes — i'll export a matrix with status (green/amber/red) per SKU and ETA.
Nora (Solutions): i'll add SI readiness column.
Lina (Partner Relations): i'll add partner signoff column.
Priya (Product): i'll draft announce timeline copy and merchant note.
Avery (Partnerships): thanks — last: who will own the post-announce rollback play if perf/regressions are reported?
Sam (Platform): Platform on-call + runtime fallback + auto-roll to last stable model. i'll own the runbook and put it in runbooks/announce-rollback.md
Avery (Partnerships): great. tagging owners in thread for follow-ups. will reconvene Fri 10:00 PT to check blockers.
Lina (Partner Relations): ack — i'll share vendor notes before the call.
Priya (Product): ack.
Diego (HW Eng): ack.
Nora (Solutions): ack.
Sam (Platform): ack.
announce-bot: Reminder scheduled for Fri 2024-06-07 17:00 PT: "Vendor roadmap sync — blockers check"
